{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Prompt: Create a dark, modern, fully responsive static editorial directory website for architecture studios called "Atlas of Spaces". The site should feel like a premium architecture video/channel browsing experience inspired by YouTube's dark interface: left sidebar navigation, large feature cards, horizontal category chips, thumbnail-style article cards, and a clean content grid. This is a pure front-end static website only, using mock/sample content. No backend, no database, no login, no real API, no live data, no authentication, and no server-side features.

Website Goal:
Build an editorial-style architecture directory where visitors can browse featured architecture studios, landmark projects, design essays, city guides, and curated lists. The website should look professional, cinematic, and minimal, with a strong dark theme and elegant typography.

Overall Style:
- Dark mode only
- Premium architecture magazine look
- Inspired by YouTube layout but adapted for editorial architecture content
- Matte black, charcoal, graphite, warm white, muted sand, bronze, and concrete gray palette
- Large image thumbnails with gradient overlays
- Clean cards, subtle borders, soft shadows, rounded corners
- Spacious layout with strong visual hierarchy
- Mobile friendly and responsive
- Use static mock images/placeholders if real images are not available

Suggested Pages / Sections:
1. Home Page
- Sticky top navigation bar with logo "Atlas of Spaces"
- Search-style input visually present only, no real search logic required
- CTA button: "Submit a Studio"
- Left sidebar like a content platform with menu items:
  Home, Studios, Projects, Cities, Materials, Interviews, Guides, Saved Ideas
- Hero section with a large featured editorial card:
  Title: "Inside the New Wave of Quiet Luxury Architecture"
  Subtitle: "A curated directory of studios, spaces, and design stories shaping contemporary cities."
  Buttons: "Browse Directory" and "Read Featured Story"
- Category chips below hero:
  Minimal Homes, Cultural Spaces, Adaptive Reuse, Brutalism, Sustainable Design, Interior Architecture, Urban Design
- Featured grid of architecture stories using video-thumbnail style cards
- Each card should include image, title, studio/city label, reading time, and small tag badge

2. Architecture Studio Directory Section
- Heading: "Featured Architecture Studios"
- Directory card grid with at least 8 mock studios
- Each studio card should include:
  Studio name
  Location
  Specialty tags
  Short editorial description
  Mock rating or editorial score like "Editor's Pick"
  Thumbnail image area
- Example static studios:
  Northline Atelier – Copenhagen – Residential / Minimalism
  Arco Forma – Milan – Hospitality / Interiors
  Stone & Radius – Mexico City – Cultural / Public Space
  Kiro Urban Lab – Tokyo – Micro Living / Urban Design
  Vanta Works – London – Adaptive Reuse
  Terra Section – Lisbon – Sustainable Housing
  Monolith House – Berlin – Brutalist Renovation
  Studio Lumen Grid – Seoul – Mixed Use / Facades
- Add filter chips visually only, no functionality needed:
  All, Residential, Commercial, Cultural, Landscape, Interiors, Sustainable

3. Editorial Feed Section
- Layout should resemble a dark YouTube home feed but with architecture articles instead of videos
- Include 12 sample article cards
- Card details:
  Thumbnail
  Article title
  Category
  Author or publication label
  Date or read time
- Sample titles:
  "How Concrete Became Warm Again"
  "The Rise of Small Footprint Homes"
  "Designing Libraries as Urban Living Rooms"
  "Muted Materials and the Future of Hospitality"
  "A Guide to Courtyard Houses in Dense Cities"
  "Why Adaptive Reuse Is the New Luxury"
  "The Return of the Monolithic Facade"
  "Inside a Studio That Designs Only With Local Stone"

4. City Guide Directory
- Section title: "Architecture City Guides"
- Cards for cities with short descriptions:
  Barcelona, Tokyo, Copenhagen, Mexico City, Rotterdam, Seoul
- Each city card should show:
  City name
  Number of featured places, example "24 spaces"
  Short editorial teaser
  Button: "View Guide"
- Static content only, buttons can link to placeholder anchors or do nothing

5. Featured Project Spotlight
- Large split layout
- Left side: big dramatic project image placeholder
- Right side: article-style text block
- Title: "Project Spotlight: The Courtyard Archive"
- Include details:
  Architect: Terra Section
  Location: Lisbon
  Type: Cultural Archive
  Materials: limestone, oak, exposed concrete
  Year: 2026
- Add a small specification table
- Add CTA: "Read Project Notes"

6. Submit a Studio Form Section
- Static front-end form only; no real submission, no backend required
- Form should look polished and editorial
- Fields:
  Studio Name
  City / Country
  Website URL
  Main Discipline dropdown
  Short Description textarea
  Upload field visual placeholder only, no real upload processing
  Checkbox: "I confirm this is a public architecture studio listing"
  Button: "Preview Submission"
- Show helper text: "This demo form is static and does not send data."
- Add clean validation styling visually if simple front-end only is easy, but no backend

7. Newsletter / Updates Block
- Dark card with title: "Weekly Architecture Dispatch"
- Subtitle: "Curated studios, spaces, essays, and city guides every Friday."
- Email input and button visually only
- Add text: "Static demo only — no email is collected."

8. Footer
- Columns:
  Explore: Studios, Projects, Cities, Materials
  Editorial: Essays, Interviews, Guides, Trends
  About: Mission, Contact, Submit, Credits
- Social-style text links
- Copyright line

Design Requirements:
- Must be fully responsive for desktop, tablet, and mobile
- Desktop should have YouTube-like side navigation and wide content grid
- Mobile should collapse sidebar into horizontal top navigation or hidden menu style
- Use dark backgrounds and high contrast text
- Use architecture-focused placeholder images or gradient image boxes if needed
- Cards should have hover effects such as slight lift, border glow, or thumbnail dimming
- Use consistent spacing and typographic hierarchy
- Include enough static content so the page looks complete and realistic

Important Constraints:
- Static website only
- Mock/sample content is enough
- No real API integrations
- No backend
- No login or accounts
- No database
- No live search required
- No payment or booking system
- No map service integration
- No 3D, WebGL, canvas game, or physics effects
- The form is only a front-end visual/static form

Deliverable:
Create the complete static front-end website with clean reusable components, polished styling, and responsive layout. The final result should feel like a dark YouTube-inspired architecture editorial directory, not a generic template.",

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
# webdev-structural-gate@1: necessary conditions, not a replacement judge.
_gate_layout = {}
for _line in (shot["output"] or "").splitlines():
    if _line.startswith("LAYOUT:"):
        try:
            _gate_layout = json.loads(_line[len("LAYOUT:"):])
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
        break
if (not isinstance(_gate_layout, dict) or _gate_layout.get("error")
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("text"), str)
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("scroll_w"), (int, float))
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("client_w"), (int, float))
        or _gate_layout["client_w"] <= 0):
    done(None, "Structural measurements unavailable; not scored.")
_gate_text = " ".join(_gate_layout["text"].split())
_gate_kw = cfg.get("gate_keywords") or []
_gate_fails = []
if not _gate_text:
    _gate_fails.append("blank rendered DOM")
if _gate_kw and not any(_kw.casefold() in _gate_text.casefold() for _kw in _gate_kw):
    _gate_fails.append("no brief-keyword DOM presence")
if _gate_layout["scroll_w"] > _gate_layout["client_w"] + 1:
    _gate_fails.append("horizontal overflow")
_gate_report = {"passed": not _gate_fails, "failed": _gate_fails,
                "dom_chars": len(_gate_text), "keywords": _gate_kw,
                "layout": _gate_layout}
(V / "structural_gates.json").write_text(json.dumps(_gate_report, indent=1))
if _gate_fails:
    done(0.0, "Structural gates failed: " + "; ".join(_gate_fails),
         structural_gates=_gate_fails)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Gate trivial, off-brief and overflowing pages to a scored 0 before the vision call, cutting judge spend and the blank-page lottery. Passing pages reach the judge unchanged.

gate_keywords: Inside the New Wave of Quiet Luxury Architecture
